question: How do the kalās pervade the entire fivefold path system?
premises: The kalās are described as pervading all paths.
The text states that by them the fivefold path is pervaded.
This is presented as an authoritative statement.
inference: The kalās are established as pervading the whole fivefold path.
plain_english: They are situated as pervading all paths; thus it is said that by them the fivefold path is pervaded.
